notes: One subject; every interval is over windows (epochs, segments or minutes) of that session, not over people.
Frontal = mean of AF7 and AF8, lateral frontal sites referenced to FPz on the Muse; this is not Fz midline theta.

Absolute power levels between sessions depend on electrode contact (the headset was re-seated); ratios are more robust, and the frontal/occipital theta ratio across sessions mostly follows the Oz cup's contact.
Theta is unmeasurable while a 6 or 7.2 Hz block is on screen (the line is inside the band); those lit epochs are left out of theta.
The 9 Hz blue plane uses the 9 Hz mask (theta 5.5-7.5 Hz only, alpha 10-10.5 Hz), so its levels are not pooled with 12 Hz stages; black epochs use one common 12 Hz mask for drift and run comparisons.
A headache has no direct EEG signature; forehead ache can only be approached indirectly (frontal beta as tension, theta as effort).
The pre-stimulus minutes are too artifacted to serve as a baseline (few usable epochs); see pre_last3min.n_ok.

Eye closure (blinkmask.closure_mask) is unmeasurable while 9 Hz is on screen (the line leaves under 2 Hz of the 8-12 Hz band and the detector switches itself off): the blue plane and the sweep's 9 Hz blocks are left out, and the detector cannot tell a closed eye from a spontaneous alpha burst.

Run 2's TP10 exceeded 150 uV in about a fifth of the epochs (minutes 10-20 most), so ear-channel levels and drift in run 2 follow that contact, not the brain; frontal markers lose those epochs by the any-channel rule.
